en.summary: Roll down neon ramps in Slope 2, a 3D arcade game. Steer around red obstacles and keep the ball on the track as it speeds up.
about: In Slope 2, the ball rolls forward on its own. The track narrows, bends and shifts as you pick up speed.
Each run ends if you hit a red obstacle or roll off the edge. Stay on the track as long as you can to beat your score.
The neon track is made up of sloping platforms. Some slide or rotate, and sharp bends can hide the next section until you get closer. Look past the ball so you have time to choose a clear line.
steps: Steer the ball
Press the left or right arrow key, or use A and D.
Look ahead on the track
Line up with the next ramp early and make small corrections as the ball speeds up.
Adjust for moving platforms
Watch where the platform is moving and aim for its middle. Readjust after landing so your next turn starts from a stable position.
Set up for turns and gaps
Start steering before a sharp bend. Before an open gap, center the ball on the ramp and point it toward the next platform.
faq: Can you jump in Slope 2?
The ball leaves the track at ramps. There is no jump button.
How do you climb the leaderboard?
Survive longer to improve your score. Avoid red obstacles and keep away from the edge, especially when the track gets faster or narrower.

hi.summary: Slope 2 एक 3D आर्केड गेम है। चमकीली ढलानों पर लुढ़कती गेंद को लाल बाधाओं से बचाएँ और बढ़ती रफ़्तार में उसे रास्ते पर रखें।
about: Slope 2 में गेंद अपने आप आगे लुढ़कती है। रफ़्तार बढ़ने पर रास्ता संकरा होता है, मुड़ता है और खिसकता है।
लाल बाधा से टकराने या किनारे से गिरने पर राउंड खत्म हो जाता है। अपना स्कोर सुधारने के लिए जितनी देर हो सके रास्ते पर बने रहें।
चमकीला रास्ता ढलान वाले हिस्सों से बना है। कुछ हिस्से खिसकते या घूमते हैं, और तीखे मोड़ के आगे का रास्ता पास आने पर ही दिखता है। गेंद से आगे देखें ताकि सुरक्षित दिशा चुनने का समय मिले।
steps: गेंद की दिशा बदलें
बाएँ या दाएँ तीर वाली कुंजी दबाएँ। आप A और D भी इस्तेमाल कर सकते हैं।
आगे का रास्ता देखें
अगली ढलान की दिशा पहले से पकड़ लें और रफ़्तार बढ़ने पर गेंद को थोड़ा-थोड़ा मोड़ें।
खिसकते हिस्सों पर दिशा सँभालें
देखें कि हिस्सा किस ओर खिसक रहा है और उसके बीच की ओर जाएँ। उतरते ही दिशा ठीक करें ताकि अगला मोड़ आसानी से ले सकें।
मोड़ और खाली जगह की तैयारी करें
तीखे मोड़ से पहले गेंद मोड़ना शुरू करें। खाली जगह से पहले गेंद को ढलान के बीच में रखें और अगले हिस्से की ओर ले जाएँ।
faq: क्या Slope 2 में छलाँग लगा सकते हैं?
गेंद ढलान के सिरे से हवा में जाती है। छलाँग के लिए कोई बटन नहीं है।
लीडरबोर्ड में ऊपर कैसे जाएँ?
स्कोर बढ़ाने के लिए ज़्यादा देर टिकें। लाल बाधाओं और किनारों से दूर रहें, खासकर जब रफ़्तार बढ़े या रास्ता संकरा हो जाए।

en.summary: Time your takeoff, flip and landing in Wacky Flip, a physics-based parkour game with rooftop stunt challenges.
about: Send your athlete off rooftops and towers and try to land inside the marked zone. Every attempt comes down to three decisions: when to take off, when to spin and when to straighten up.
A clean landing earns points for the flips you completed in the air. Once you can land a single flip reliably, try combining moves for a multiplier.
steps: Controls
Hold the mouse button to set the jump, then release to take off. Click in midair to flip and click again to prepare for landing.
Start with a simple attempt
Use one flip to learn how long the jump lasts. Straighten up while there is still room to reach the target on your feet.
faq: Why did the stunt score nothing?
The flips only count if you finish with a clean landing in the target zone.

hi.summary: Wacky Flip में छतों से छलाँग लगाएँ और सही समय पर पलटी लेकर तय जगह पर उतरें।
about: खिलाड़ी को छतों और मीनारों से उछालें और निशान वाली जगह पर उतारें। तय करें कि कब कूदना है, कब पलटी लेनी है और कब शरीर सीधा करना है।
साफ़ लैंडिंग पर हवा में पूरी की गई पलटियों के अंक मिलते हैं। एक पलटी के बाद लगातार सही उतरने लगें, तो अंक बढ़ाने के लिए अलग-अलग करतब जोड़ें।
steps: नियंत्रण
छलाँग तैयार करने के लिए माउस बटन दबाए रखें और कूदने के लिए छोड़ें। हवा में पलटी के लिए क्लिक करें और उतरने की तैयारी के लिए फिर क्लिक करें।
आसान कोशिश से शुरू करें
एक पलटी लेकर देखें कि हवा में कितना समय मिलता है। निशान पर पैरों के बल पहुँचने के लिए समय रहते सीधे हो जाएँ।
faq: करतब के अंक क्यों नहीं मिले?
पलटियाँ तभी गिनी जाती हैं जब आप निशान वाली जगह पर ठीक से उतरते हैं।

en.summary: Draw shapes that move under gravity to solve Brain Lines puzzles, from guiding a ball into a cup to balancing objects.
about: Every puzzle has a target. You might need to guide a ball into a cup, balance an object or trigger a mechanism. Your drawings become objects that can fall, push or block things on the board.
A slanted stroke can act as a ramp. A shape placed above an object can fall onto it and give it a push. Watch where your drawing comes to rest before adding another one.
steps: Controls
Hold and drag the mouse to draw a line or shape. Release it to let the drawing interact with the objects on the board.
Start with a simple attempt
Look at where the object needs to end up. Place one short stroke that nudges it in that direction, then watch what happens.
faq: Can a puzzle have more than one solution?
Yes. Different drawings can clear the same stage as long as they achieve its objective.

hi.summary: Brain Lines में आकृतियाँ बनाकर भौतिकी की पहेलियाँ हल करें। गेंद को कप तक पहुँचाएँ या वस्तुओं का संतुलन बनाएँ।
about: हर पहेली का लक्ष्य अलग है। कभी गेंद को कप में पहुँचाना होता है, कभी किसी चीज़ को संतुलित करना या कोई यंत्र चलाना होता है। आपकी बनाई आकृतियाँ गिर सकती हैं और बोर्ड की दूसरी चीज़ों को धकेल या रोक सकती हैं।
तिरछी रेखा ढलान बन सकती है। किसी वस्तु के ऊपर बनाई आकृति गिरकर उसे धक्का दे सकती है। अगली रेखा बनाने से पहले देखें कि पहली कहाँ रुकती है।
steps: नियंत्रण
रेखा या आकृति बनाने के लिए माउस बटन दबाकर खींचें। उसे छोड़कर देखें कि आकृति बोर्ड की चीज़ों से कैसे टकराती है।
आसान कोशिश से शुरू करें
पहले देखें कि वस्तु को कहाँ पहुँचाना है। उस दिशा में हल्का धक्का देने के लिए छोटी रेखा बनाएँ और नतीजा देखें।
faq: क्या एक पहेली के कई हल हो सकते हैं?
हाँ। अलग-अलग चित्र उसी स्तर को पूरा कर सकते हैं, बशर्ते वे उसका लक्ष्य पूरा करें।

en.summary: Ride a motorbike through first-person highway traffic in Traffic Road. Race the clock in Career or see how far you can go in Endless.
about: Ride from the motorcyclist’s point of view and scan for a clear lane. Slow down if traffic closes the gap, then pass once you have room to steer.
Career sends you through timed stages on one-way roads. Endless lets you choose one-way or two-way traffic and rewards distance. Time Trial and Free Ride unlock as you progress.
steps: Controls
Use the arrow keys to steer and adjust your speed. Look past the nearest vehicle before changing lanes.
Start with a simple attempt
Try one-way traffic first. Leave yourself room to slow down when the gap between two vehicles starts to close.
faq: When can you play Time Trial and Free Ride?
Both modes become available after you reach the required level.

hi.summary: Traffic Road में मोटरसाइकिल से हाईवे के ट्रैफ़िक से निकलें। करियर में समय से दौड़ें या एंडलेस में लंबी दूरी तय करें।
about: सड़क को मोटरसाइकिल चालक की नज़र से देखें और खाली लेन तलाशें। गाड़ियों के बीच जगह घटने पर रफ़्तार कम करें और रास्ता खुलने पर आगे निकलें।
करियर में एकतरफ़ा सड़कों पर समयबद्ध स्तर हैं। एंडलेस में एकतरफ़ा या दोतरफ़ा ट्रैफ़िक चुनकर लंबी दूरी तय करें। आगे बढ़ने पर टाइम ट्रायल और फ़्री राइड खुलते हैं।
steps: नियंत्रण
दिशा और रफ़्तार बदलने के लिए तीर वाली कुंजियाँ इस्तेमाल करें। लेन बदलने से पहले सबसे पास की गाड़ी से आगे देखें।
आसान कोशिश से शुरू करें
पहले एकतरफ़ा ट्रैफ़िक चुनें। दो गाड़ियों के बीच जगह घटे तो रफ़्तार कम करने के लिए गुंजाइश रखें।
faq: टाइम ट्रायल और फ़्री राइड कब खेल सकते हैं?
ज़रूरी स्तर तक पहुँचने के बाद दोनों मोड उपलब्ध हो जाते हैं।

en.summary: Steer a sled through shifting winter hazards in Slope Rider. Jump over logs, collect coins and unlock sleds for your next descent.
about: Each run sends your sled down a winter course with a new mix of steep drops, narrow turns and obstacles. Rolling logs and snow boulders can cross a lane that looked clear a moment earlier, so watch the slope ahead.
Collect coins and items to unlock more sleds. Their handling and jump characteristics can change how early you need to move when a hazard appears.

Give moving hazards more room than fixed obstacles. A log rolling across your path can keep moving while you jump, so look at where it will be when you land. Daily missions give you a separate objective to work toward while you collect coins and try for a longer run.
steps: Steer the sled
Use the left and right arrow keys to change direction. Look for a clear route past the obstacle before committing to a move.
Time each jump
Press the up arrow to jump. Go late enough to clear the hazard and check where the sled will come down.
Leave room on the downhill
On tight sections, prioritize an open lane. Pick up coins when you can reach them without crossing a moving obstacle.
Read the slope beyond the turn
At a bend or steep drop, look for the next stretch of snow you can see. Make one deliberate steering adjustment and wait until the following section comes into view before committing to another.
faq: Is the course the same every run?
The course changes between runs, with obstacles in different places. Use each attempt to practice reading the next stretch of slope.
When should I steer around a log instead of jumping?
Steer around it if there is an open route with room to straighten out afterward. Jump when the ground route is blocked and you can see clear snow beyond the log.
What should I look for in another sled?
Compare handling and jump timing. If you often overshoot a turn, look for a sled you can steer comfortably through a tight section.
en.aboutTitle: How the downhill run changes

en.summary: Time a kick, guide the ball through the air and upgrade its bounce in Orbit Kick, a distance game that takes you past world landmarks.
about: Start each run with a timed kick. The ball bounces across hills and ramps, and a well-placed bounce can carry it farther. You can make small corrections in the air as the ground comes into view.
Distance earns coins that you can spend on stronger kicks, better bounces or offline earnings. Reach new distances to see more landmarks and unlock additional balls and gear.

The first bounce helps you judge whether your launch worked. If the ball reaches a downhill section or a ramp while it still has speed, it can carry on toward the next landmark. Watch what happens on similar kicks before spending coins, so you can tell whether you need more launch power or more distance between bounces.
steps: Time the kick
Click when the power indicator reaches the strongest part of its range. A strong launch gives the ball more speed at the start.
Guide the ball in flight
Drag the pointer to make small adjustments. Aim for a clear landing or a useful ramp.
Choose an upgrade
Use Power to improve the launch and Bounce to keep the ball moving after it lands. Look at where your last attempt lost momentum before spending coins.
Practice consistent kick timing
Watch the power indicator through one full cycle before you click. Try to hit the same part of the indicator on your next few kicks so you can see which flight adjustments help.
faq: What does the Bounce upgrade change?
It helps the ball carry farther after touching down. Power affects the kick at the beginning of the run.
Can I still steer after kicking the ball?
Yes. Drag the pointer for small corrections in the air. Pick a place to land before making your adjustment.
What is Offline Earnings for?
It improves the coins earned while you are away. Upgrade Power or Bounce if your immediate goal is to push your next kick farther.
en.aboutTitle: What carries the ball farther

en.summary: Build momentum across desert dunes in Curve Rush. Launch above the skyline for bonus points and land on the slope to keep rolling.
about: Your ball rolls over an endless line of sand dunes. You can launch it from the crest of a dune and earn extra points by crossing the white line overhead. A hard impact can end the run.
Look for a downhill surface before coming back to the sand. Matching the curve lets you keep more speed and sets you up for the next jump.

Try linking several short jumps. If you release just as the dune curves up and touch down on the next downhill face, the ball has a chance to keep its speed into the following climb. A sequence of clean landings gives you more chances to cross the white line later in the run.
steps: Build momentum
Hold the left mouse button as the ball follows the slope, then release as it approaches a crest to set up the jump.
Read the landing
Look at the next dune while the ball is in the air. Aim to meet a descending slope and carry the speed into the next section.
Work up to higher jumps
Practice low flights until you can land smoothly. With more speed, try crossing the white line for a bonus.
Set up the next takeoff after landing
As soon as the ball is back on a downhill slope, watch for the next upward curve. Hold to build speed on the ground and release when the crest can send you up.
faq: Why did my ball break on landing?
A steep impact can shatter it. Look for a sloping landing surface and try a lower jump while you learn the timing.
What does the white line in the sky do?
Crossing it earns a height bonus. Try for it when you have enough speed and can see a landing slope ahead.
Should I aim for the highest jump every time?
Shorter jumps make it easier to practice landing on a downward slope. Once you can keep rolling after several landings, use that speed to try a higher flight.
en.aboutTitle: Build speed from one dune to the next

en.summary: Race across waves, collect coins and land flips in Jetski Race. Handle ramps and obstacles to reach the finish ahead of the other riders.
about: Each race sends you through a water course with waves, jumps and obstacles. Speed helps on open stretches, while the angle of your craft matters as you leave a ramp and come back down.
Coins and daily objectives help you unlock more craft and upgrade coin value or flip boosts. As the routes get trickier, look farther ahead for a clear approach to the next wave.

A wave gives you a chance to gain speed or attempt a trick. Look at the water ahead before committing to a rotation. If an obstacle sits just beyond the ramp, a smooth approach gives you more time to steer as soon as the craft lands.
steps: Accelerate and steer
Hold and drag the mouse to power and guide the craft. On a keyboard, use the up arrow for the engine and the left or right arrow to steer.
Land cleanly
Use the space above a wave to attempt a flip. Leave enough time to level the craft before it touches down.
Choose your line
Steer around obstacles early. Keep an eye out for coins along a line you can follow without losing control.
Try a flip with the mouse
While using the mouse controls, release the button after takeoff and hold it again in midair to flip. Practice on a wave with open water ahead so you have room to correct the landing.
faq: What upgrades can I buy?
The game offers upgrades for coin value and flip boosts, and you can unlock different craft as you progress.
Why does the craft capsize after a jump?
It can tip if you finish the rotation too late. Attempt a single flip and watch the water so you can level out before touching down.
What can I work on between races?
Check the daily objectives and the shop. A short race can still earn coins toward another craft or toward a coin-value upgrade.
en.aboutTitle: Use the waves without losing race position

en.summary: Pass, steal and time a dunk in Dunk Dash, an arcade basketball game with full-court play and moving baskets.
about: Take possession, move around defenders and use passes to create a clear route to the basket. Timing matters near the rim, where a jump can turn into a dunk if you are in range.
Later rounds move the basket and make it harder to finish a drive. Watch the hoop while you approach and pass if a teammate has a better angle.

A good possession can start with a pass away from the hoop. Move the ball to a teammate with a clear lane, then approach from a position where you can see both the defender and the basket. On rounds with a moving rim, check its direction before making that final run.
steps: Move into space
Use the arrow keys or WASD to move. Look for an open lane or a teammate the defense has left free.
Pass or steal
Use the left mouse button for the current action, such as passing when your team has the ball or attempting a steal on defense.
Time the finish
Use the mouse or Space to jump or dunk in range. In rounds with a moving hoop, line up with where it is heading.
Defend the lane first
When the other team has the ball, move between the ball carrier and the basket. Get close enough to try a steal when you have a good angle.
faq: Why did my jump miss the dunk?
Check your distance from the rim before jumping. When the basket moves, wait until it comes into range.
When is passing better than driving to the rim?
Pass when a defender cuts off your route and a teammate has space to move. A clean catch can start another approach before the defender sets up again.
What changes when the basket moves?
It can leave dunk range while you are approaching. Follow where it is going and time your jump when the gap closes.
en.aboutTitle: Create a clear approach to the basket

en.summary: Race a sled down winding mountain tracks in Snow Road 3D. Avoid falling ice, collect gifts and unlock more snowmobiles.
about: The mountain route narrows around obstacles and opens up at icy ramps. Change lanes early when icicles or other hazards block your path, especially if you are about to land from a jump.
Gifts along the track help unlock more snowmobiles. Different rides offer changes in speed, stability and acceleration, which matter as you move on to tougher routes.

A ramp can carry you past a hazard. If a narrow stretch follows the ramp, line up with it before leaving the ground. As the course gets tighter, compare snowmobiles on a few sections you already know so you can get used to the way each one steers.
steps: Steer through bends
Use the left and right arrows or A and D. Watch the track beyond the nearest obstacle to leave room for the next turn.
Jump over a hazard
Use the up arrow or Space to jump. Before taking off, check where you will land.
Collect gifts on clear routes
Take gifts when your line is clear. Save them toward another snowmobile instead of crossing a narrow section for a single pickup.
Plan for two obstacles at a time
When an obstacle blocks your lane just before a turn, look ahead to the space you need after the turn. An early move can leave you lined up for both.
faq: What are the gifts for?
Use the gifts you collect to unlock snowmobiles with different handling and performance.
Can I steer and jump with different keys?
Yes. Use A and D to steer while keeping your other hand on Space to jump. The arrow keys also cover both actions.
When should I skip a gift?
Skip it if reaching it would make you cross in front of an obstacle or land on the edge of a narrow track. You can collect more gifts on a later run.
en.aboutTitle: Read the mountain track before you jump

en.summary: Balance a bike across steep trails, ramps and narrow bridges in Bike Xtreme. Land tricks to earn points and unlock harder rides.
about: The trails alternate between steep climbs, short ramps and narrow crossings. Control speed and lean together so the bike stays balanced as the ground angle changes.
Tricks earn points and help open new challenges. Gear upgrades can make a difference to speed, stability or control as the trails get more demanding.

How you reach a ramp affects what you can do in the air. A short jump leaves little time to lean or rotate. On a steep descent, keep the bike aligned with the ground as it drops away, then use the next clear stretch to gather speed for another obstacle.
steps: Control your speed
Use the up and down arrow keys to drive. Slow down before a narrow bridge or a steep drop if you need time to adjust.
Balance the bike
Use the left and right arrows to lean. On a jump, line up the wheels with the landing surface.
Build up to bigger tricks
Practice a clean landing on a short ramp. Attempt a larger rotation once you can judge how much time the bike will spend in the air.
Separate the approach from the landing
Set your speed while both wheels are on the ground. Once the bike is in the air, use the lean controls to match the angle of the trail ahead.
faq: How do I get more trails?
Progress through the current challenges and score points with tricks to open additional rides.
Why do I lose balance on steep descents?
Large corrections are harder to recover from when the slope changes quickly. Try a slower approach and use smaller taps on the lean controls.
When is a ramp big enough for a trick?
Watch a straightforward jump first. If it leaves time to rotate and still line up both wheels before landing, try a trick on the next attempt.
en.aboutTitle: Control the bike through changes in slope

en.summary: Fit blocks into full rows and columns in Bricky Blast. Clear several lines at once and keep enough space for the next shape.
about: Drag each block onto the board. A filled row or column disappears, making room for later pieces. A move that completes several lines at once can earn a combo.
The round ends when no available piece fits. Keep an area open for bigger blocks and think about what the next placement will leave behind.

Think about the shape of the space that will remain after a clear. If a larger piece only fits in one corner, use that opening before placing a smaller piece there. A line clear that connects two small openings can make room for several future moves.
steps: Place a block
Drag one of the available shapes into empty spaces on the grid. Check how it fits next to the blocks already on the board.
Clear intersecting lines
Look where a single piece can complete both a row and a column. Clearing them together frees space and earns more points.
Preserve room for large pieces
Avoid filling every small gap if it splits the last open area. Leave space for a shape you cannot place anywhere else.
Check the least flexible shape before placing it
Look at all available pieces and find the one with the fewest places it can fit. If it only fits in one spot, keep that spot available while you decide how to use the smaller blocks.
faq: Why did the round end with empty squares left?
The remaining openings may be too small or have the wrong shape for every available piece.
What counts as a combo?
Finish more than one row or column with the same placement. For example, a block dropped at the intersection of two nearly full lines can clear both.
Does leaving empty squares guarantee another move?
A piece needs empty squares arranged in its exact shape. Several isolated spaces can leave you with fewer options than one open rectangle.
en.aboutTitle: Clear lines without closing off the board

en.summary: Jump between colored platforms in Color Rush and switch your runner's color before landing. Return for three extra goals per level.
about: Your runner moves forward automatically. To stay on the course, jump across gaps and match the color of the platform you are about to land on. Some sections ask you to do both in the same move.
Later layouts mix color transitions with trickier jumps. Each level also has three optional objectives, giving you a reason to replay a route after reaching the finish.

Look at the platform ahead before you reach the edge. Check the gap to decide how long to hold jump, then check the platform color to see whether you need Space. Later levels add moves such as double jumps and head jumps, so changes in height matter as much as changes in color.
steps: Jump with the up arrow
Tap the up arrow for a short jump or hold it for a longer one. Look at the gap before deciding how long to hold it.
Switch with Space
Press Space to change your runner's color. Read the next platform early so the color matches by the time you land.
Combine jump and color change
When the far platform is a different color, use the up arrow and Space together. Practice the movement before going for extra goals.
Practice the difficult color change on a replay
Once you can clear a level, use a replay to focus on the jump or color change that gave you trouble. Learn the approach before attempting one of the extra objectives on that route.
faq: Do I need to finish every optional objective on the first run?
You can return to a level to try its extra goals after learning the route.
Why did I miss a platform even though the jump was long enough?
Check your runner’s color at the moment of landing. If it differs from the platform, press Space sooner on your next attempt.
How should I jump a wider gap?
Hold the up arrow longer. If the far platform is a different color, combine the jump with Space so the runner arrives in the right color.
en.aboutTitle: Read the next platform while you are still running

en.summary: Click the dancing robot to earn AstroCoins, buy upgrades and unlock more characters in Astro Robot Clicker.
about: Each click on the robot earns AstroCoins. Spend them on upgrades to build up earnings and reach the next unlock sooner.
Progress opens up other robots and weather effects. Check the costs in the upgrade menu and decide whether to buy a small improvement now or save toward a larger one.

Check the prices when you open the upgrade menu. Pick one purchase to aim for, then watch how quickly your balance grows after you buy it. If you want to see a new robot or weather effect, save toward its next requirement once you have a few early upgrades.
steps: Earn your first coins
Click the robot and watch the AstroCoin counter. The coins are the currency for upgrades.
Spend on an upgrade
Compare the prices in the upgrade menu and buy an improvement when you can afford it.
Check new unlocks
As your total grows, look for more robots and changes to the scene. Keep earning toward the upgrade you want next.
Compare progress before and after an upgrade
Note your balance, click for a short stretch, and see how quickly it grows. Repeat after a purchase to decide whether you want another small upgrade or to save for a more expensive one.
faq: What do I use AstroCoins for?
Spend them on upgrades. Continued progress also opens up new robots and weather effects.
Where do AstroCoins come from at the start?
Click the robot on the main screen. Check the coin counter, then open the upgrade menu when you have enough for your first purchase.
What can I unlock as I progress?
The game features robot characters such as Pinkbot and Astro Krabot, along with different weather effects for the scene.
en.aboutTitle: Spend AstroCoins with the next unlock in mind

en.summary: Surf through an endless water course in Wave Rider. Jump past hazards, pick up pearls and keep your board's durability above zero.
en.aboutTitle: Read the current and keep your board afloat
about: Wave Rider starts with a drop over a waterfall. Your board carries you downstream past plants, barriers and moving obstacles. Some bends narrow quickly, so scan for a clear route before the current takes you into the next stretch.
The run ends when the board runs out of durability. A single collision can leave you room to recover. After a hit, steer into open water before looking for another pickup or ramp.

Pearls appear along routes that can bring you close to hazards. A ramp or short glide may help you cross a tricky stretch. Check where you will come back down before you follow a pearl into a narrow section.
steps: Steer downstream
Use the left and right arrow keys to move the board sideways. Start adjusting while the next gap is still ahead of you.
Jump or glide past a hazard
Use Space or the up arrow. Look for open water beyond the obstacle so you have room to steer again after landing.
Give obscured areas more room
Plants and other objects can hide what comes next. When your view is limited, favor a route that leaves room for a second correction.
Collect pearls on a clean line
Approach a pearl when you can see a route out of the section. If reaching it would take you straight into a barrier, stay in the open lane.
faq: What ends a run in Wave Rider?
The run ends when your board's durability reaches zero. Repeated collisions shorten the distance you can travel.
Which keys make the board jump?
Press the up arrow or Space to jump or glide. The left and right arrows steer sideways.
Do I have to collect every pearl?
No. Pearls are optional pickups. Leave yourself a clear route downstream if a pearl is next to an obstacle.

en.summary: Guide a wobbly animal through an obstacle course in Wobbly Pets. Time each step with Space or a click and see how far you can reach.
en.aboutTitle: Find a steady rhythm through the obstacle course
about: You guide a small pet along a course by timing its steps. Its movement responds to each press, so a rhythm that works on open ground may need to change when the path gets tight.
Watch the pet's current motion before giving it another input. Fast repeated presses can make its steps less stable, particularly when it is already wobbling near an obstacle.

Some sections call for a brief pause while an obstacle moves. Use that time to look at the gap ahead and decide when to take the next step. A run measures how far you can carry that control through the course.
steps: Start with one input
Press Space or click once with the left mouse button. Watch how the pet moves before pressing again.
Set a rhythm on open ground
Use an open stretch to find a pace you can repeat. Break the rhythm when the pet needs time to settle.
Watch moving obstacles first
Look at the full movement of the obstacle when you have space to wait. Take the next step when the path opens.
Change one thing after a stumble
If you keep losing balance in the same place, try waiting slightly longer before your next input. Compare the result before changing your pace again.
faq: Can I use a mouse instead of Space?
Yes. The left mouse button and Space both control the pet's movement.
Why does the pet wobble more when I tap faster?
Rapid presses can interrupt its movement. Give the current step time to settle, especially on a narrow stretch.
How can I get farther on the next run?
Keep a steady pace where the path is clear. Slow down long enough to check the timing of moving obstacles before stepping past them.

en.summary: Play Tube Fight solo or share a keyboard for a local face-off. Try parody-inspired fighters and time short combos in compact arenas.
en.aboutTitle: Learn each fighter's timing in a small arena
about: Tube Fight pits parody-inspired characters against each other in short arena matches. Fighters differ in movement, combo style and how quickly they can act again after an attack.

Start by learning how much space your fighter needs for an attack. If the opening hit misses, leave time to recover before starting another sequence. Repeating attacks at the wrong distance gives the opponent an opening.
Solo mode lets you practice with one control set. Local two-player mode splits movement and attacks between opposite sides of the keyboard, so both players can act in the same round.
steps: Learn the solo controls
Use WASD or the arrow keys to move. Press Space to attack.
Set up a local match
Player 1 uses WASD and Space. Player 2 uses the arrow keys and the numeric keypad's 1 key.
Start with a short sequence
Move into range and try a short combo. Back off if the first attack misses, then wait for a chance to move in again.
Compare two fighters
Try the same approach with a different character. Pay attention to changes in movement speed and recovery before attempting a longer sequence.
faq: Can two people play on the same keyboard?
Yes. Choose two-player mode and use the two control sets. The second player's attack is Numpad 1.
Why does my fighter get hit after I miss?
An attack takes time to finish. If it misses, the opponent can close the gap before your fighter is ready to act again.
Do the fighters play differently?
Yes. Characters have different movement and combo timing. Try a few rounds with each before deciding which one suits you.

en.summary: Break furniture and equipment in timed virtual rooms in School Fury. Chain hits for points and spend coins to unlock tools and areas.
en.aboutTitle: Chain object hits across timed rooms
about: School Fury takes place in a cartoon environment with destructible props. Move through virtual classrooms, hallways and labs and score by breaking furniture and equipment during a timed run.

The room layout shapes your route. A cluster of props lets you continue a combo without spending much time moving. Clear adjacent objects in a sequence before crossing a corridor to reach the next cluster.
Coins from runs help unlock equipment, and progress can open more rooms. Try a new tool in a room you already know to judge how quickly it lets you move from one object to the next.
steps: Move around the room
Use WASD or the arrow keys. Look for a group of nearby props before starting your combo.
Use the action button
Press Space to break or interact with an object in range. Move toward the next nearby prop while you still have time to continue the sequence.
Plan a short route
Work through a row of desks or equipment in order. If the next object is across the room, look for a nearer cluster before making the trip.
Spend your coins between runs
Check the available tools and choose one that helps with your current goal. Compare your score in a familiar room after the purchase.
faq: What earns points in a room?
Break the virtual props and link nearby hits into combos. Clearing more objects within the time limit gives you more chances to raise your score.
Which key breaks objects?
Press Space when you are within range. Use WASD or the arrow keys to move around the room.
How do I get more equipment?
Earn coins during runs and use them to unlock tools. Progress also opens more virtual areas to try.

en.summary: Compete in sprints, jumps, throws and swimming in Retro Sports Champion. Learn when to tap, take off and release across tournament events.
en.aboutTitle: Change your rhythm for each event
about: Retro Sports Champion puts pixel athletes into short events such as the 100-meter sprint, long jump, javelin and swimming. Each event uses the same pair of movement inputs, with timing cues that change from one competition to the next.

The sprint rewards a quick, steady rhythm. In long jump and javelin, the run-up sets up one decisive action. Watch the takeoff board or foul line instead of carrying the same sprint rhythm all the way through.

Tournaments combine multiple rounds. Match results can earn coins and experience toward more athletes with different strengths. If one event consistently costs you places, practice its timing cue before tackling another tournament.
steps: Learn the pair of controls
Use A and D or the left and right arrow keys. Read the prompt at the start of each event to see how that event uses them.
Build a steady sprint rhythm
Tap rhythmically through the 100 meters. Once you can hold a consistent pace, try increasing it without losing the pattern.
Watch the launch point
In long jump, time your takeoff at the board. In javelin, watch the release angle and the foul line during the approach.
Adjust to the next sport
When the tournament switches to swimming or hurdles, look for its stroke or jump cues. Use the first round to learn where those cues appear.
faq: Are all sports controlled the same way?
They use the same two inputs, but each event has its own timing. A sprint needs repeated taps, while a jump or throw depends on the final action.
How do I unlock more athletes?
Play events and earn coins and experience. Progress opens athletes with different stats and strengths.
Why is my sprint rhythm not working in the long jump?
The long jump also needs a well-timed takeoff. Build speed on the approach, then focus on the board as you come up to it.

en.summary: Survive an endless kitchen obstacle course in Wurst Dash. Hold to speed up, release to slow down, and time each crossing past the traps.
en.aboutTitle: Read the traps before speeding up
about: Your sausage moves forward on its own through a cartoon kitchen. Hold the mouse button to speed up and release to slow down. The run ends when a trap catches you.

Each obstacle has a different timing cue. A hammer gives you a chance to cross as it rises. Before a spinning blade, watch how long the opening stays clear and account for what lies immediately beyond it.
Longer runs help you earn coins for costumes. Aim for steady progress through the crowded sections. Short bursts of speed give you more control when two traps are close together.
steps: Learn the mouse timing
Hold the mouse button to accelerate. Release it as you approach the next trap so you can watch the opening.
Read a full cycle
If space allows, slow down and watch the trap move once before trying to pass.
Check the next obstacle
Look beyond the first blade or hammer. When two traps are close, release after the first crossing so you have time to judge the second.
Use speed on a clear stretch
Hold the button when there is room ahead. Let up again before you reach the next cluster of traps.
faq: Can I stop the runner completely?
Releasing the button slows the runner. Leave yourself time to react while it continues moving.
What are coins for?
The coins you earn during runs can be spent on sausage skins and costumes.
Why do I keep getting caught after the first trap?
You may be carrying too much speed into the next obstacle. Release once you are clear of the first trap and check the next opening.

en.summary: Strike left or right to fend off incoming waves in Tap Brawl. Time your hits, watch both sides, and earn coins toward new fighters.
en.aboutTitle: Read both sides of the arena
about: Your fighter stays at the center while enemies approach from the left and right. Your two commands strike in different directions, so you need to read which enemy will arrive first.

Early waves give you time to see the rhythm. Later enemies arrive more quickly and can approach from both directions close together. Look across the arena after each hit so you can anticipate the next one.
Surviving longer helps you build a score and earn coins for more fighters. Use early attempts to get comfortable with the two keys and notice whether you tend to strike too soon or on the wrong side.
steps: Strike to the left
Press the left arrow or A when an enemy enters range on the left.
Strike to the right
Press the right arrow or D for an enemy on the right. You do not need to move the character.
Read arrivals before picking a side
When enemies approach together, watch which one will reach you first. Check the other side immediately after that hit.
Practice deliberate inputs
Avoid alternating keys at random. Try to use one intentional strike per arrival while learning the early waves.
faq: How do I move in Tap Brawl?
The fighter stays in place. The arrow keys or A and D choose the direction of your strike.
What do I spend coins on?
Coins from survival runs unlock fighters with different visual styles.
Why do later waves feel harder?
Enemies approach faster and more closely together. Start watching the next arrival while the current enemy is still in range.

en.summary: Switch between cars and on-foot routes in Escape Road 3, a blocky arcade chase with varied maps, vehicle customization and minigames.
en.aboutTitle: Switch routes as the arcade chase changes
about: Escape Road 3 drops you into a blocky arcade pursuit. Steer through traffic and look ahead for the next turn. Some routes narrow into alleys, while others bring you to water or terrain that changes how you can continue.

You can leave a vehicle and move on foot, then enter another vehicle. Watch your current vehicle and the space around it before getting out. The change of controls is easier to manage when you can already see where to go next.
This entry adds more maps, playable characters, vehicle customization and occasional minigames. Try one vehicle setup for a few runs to see how it feels around corners before switching to another.
steps: Steer or run with the same keys
Use WASD or the arrow keys. The controls steer when you are in a vehicle and move your character when you are on foot.
Read the map ahead
Look for the next intersection while you still have room to turn. A tight opening can leave less room for a second correction.
Enter or leave with Space
Press Space when you need to switch between driving and moving on foot. Check the space around your character before switching.
Try a different in-game vehicle setup
Use the customization options to compare how a vehicle feels on a familiar route. Change one part of your setup at a time.
faq: Can I leave my starting car?
Yes. Space lets you exit or enter a vehicle. Use the direction keys to move on foot between vehicles.
What is new in Escape Road 3?
This entry includes additional maps and characters, vehicle customization and minigames alongside the chase.
What should I do when the in-game car is heavily damaged?
Look for an open area where you can switch to moving on foot or enter another vehicle. Plan where to go before pressing Space.

en.summary: Launch Doofus down a cartoon slope in Farting Flight. Adjust launch power and learn how boosts, hills and obstacles affect each descent.
en.aboutTitle: Match launch power to the terrain
about: Doofus tumbles downhill through an obstacle course shaped by momentum. A long hold can send him farther at the start, while the angle of the slope affects how the first landing turns out.

Boosts can change speed and trajectory quickly. Look at the slope and hazards ahead before using a boost opportunity. Extra speed on a clear descent gives you more room to react than extra speed on a crowded stretch.
Judge each attempt by where it first becomes difficult to control. Try a shorter hold if an early launch leaves you spinning. Adjust one part of the timing at a time so you can see what changed.
steps: Start the attempt
Click to start. Hold the launch input to build power, then release to send Doofus down the slope.
Watch the first landing
Follow the angle of the next section. Use the result to decide whether to hold the launch longer or release earlier on your next try.
Read the terrain around boosts
Check for obstacles beyond a boost point. Use an open slope to learn how the boost changes the path through the air.
Repeat a manageable launch
Use a similar hold on a few tries. Once the opening feels predictable, change the release timing and compare the distance.
faq: How do I increase launch power?
Hold the launch input longer before releasing.
Why do two launches travel different distances?
Launch timing, the slope, boosts and collisions all affect the trajectory. Watch the first landing to see where the attempts start to differ.
Should I always use the strongest launch?
A moderate launch can be easier to control on a steep or crowded section. Try more power once you know where a clean landing is likely.

en.summary: Manage suspicion during a fictional classroom test in Cheat or Repeat. Switch views, react to sound cues, and enter answers before the next inspection.
en.aboutTitle: Use short actions between inspection cues
about: Cheat or Repeat is a fictional stealth game set during a classroom test. You alternate between the answer sheet, the room and the character's phone while the teacher moves around and the suspicion level changes.

Treat classroom sounds as cues to check your current view. If a warning plays while the phone is open, return to the paper view promptly. Watch the on-screen indicators so you know which action the game expects next.
Search actions can reveal clues and the number pad enters multiple-choice answers. Learn those inputs early so switching from a clue to the answer sheet feels familiar when an inspection approaches.
steps: Switch between the paper and the room
Left-click to look at the answer sheet. Right-click to look around the classroom.
Open the phone with Space
Use a brief look to read the clue. Return to the paper view when the game signals an approaching inspection.
Follow the search indicators
Use W, A, S, D, Q or E as prompted. Check the active indicator before choosing a key.
Enter the answer on the number pad
Use Numpad 1–4 for choices A through D. Verify the choice before moving to the next clue.
faq: What do the warning sounds mean?
They can signal an inspection or a change in what is happening in the room. Switch back to the paper view and check the current cues.
Which keys select answers?
Numpad 1, 2, 3 and 4 select A, B, C and D respectively.
Why does suspicion rise quickly?
The game tracks exposed actions such as leaving the phone open. Use brief actions and watch for changes in the teacher's position and the warning cues.

en.summary: Guide a growing hole through city blocks in Hole Arena. Eat small objects first, take on larger targets and choose when to use power-ups.
en.aboutTitle: Grow through the city one block at a time
about: At the start of a match, your opening is too small for most of the city. Clear a tight group of props you can already swallow. Once you grow, check parked vehicles and other targets you passed earlier.

Watch the size of rival holes as you move between groups of objects. A larger rival can swallow you, so leave space to turn away. Check the clock before crossing a sparse block when another set of smaller objects is nearby.

Power-ups solve different problems. Magnet pulls in nearby objects, Speed helps in transit, Get Bigger increases your starting size and Shrink makes some targets easier to swallow. Pick the boost that fits the stage of the match.
steps: Move across the map
Drag with the mouse or use the arrow keys. Guide the center of the hole under objects that fit.
Clear a group of small props
Make several pickups in one area before heading for a large target. Check the new size of the opening after you grow.
Keep clear of larger rivals
When a bigger hole enters your block, move toward open space or another group of objects that you can reach safely.
Use boosts where they save time
Use Magnet near a crowd of small props. Consider Shrink if nearby targets are still too large to swallow.
faq: Why does the hole roll past some objects?
They may be wider than the opening. Eat smaller objects to grow, or use Shrink to reduce a nearby target.
How do I move faster?
Use the Speed boost. The arrow keys and mouse drag control direction.
Is there a mode beyond timed matches?
Yes. The game also offers Endless mode and side missions with their own objectives.

en.summary: Switch legs to walk through Long Leg Master. Time short strides, correct your balance on uneven ground and see how far your character can go.
en.aboutTitle: Watch the body before taking the next step
about: Long Leg Master turns each stride into a balance decision. Press Space or click to switch the active leg, then watch how the character moves before you switch again.

The tall body can lean ahead of its legs when it builds momentum. Smaller steps on uneven terrain give you more chances to recover. Use the first few steps to learn the timing before trying to gain distance quickly.

The character's eyes give you a clue when balance starts to go. If a section keeps ending your run, watch the body during the preceding stride. Adjust that input first and see whether the next switch leaves you upright.
steps: Switch the active leg
Press Space or click the left mouse button. Wait for the stride to develop so you can see where the body is leaning.
Find a repeatable pace
Take a few short strides on clear ground. Learn how much momentum builds between switches.
Shorten steps on uneven terrain
Make smaller adjustments when the next foothold changes height. Check the alignment of the legs before adding speed.
Study the stride before a fall
Review which leg was active when the body leaned forward. Try changing the timing of that switch on the next run.
faq: Do I need separate keys for the two legs?
No. Space or left-click switches which leg is active.
Why does speeding up end my run?
Longer, rushed strides can move the body too far ahead of its legs. Try a smaller step before the next switch.
What happens after a fall?
A fall ends the current attempt. Start again and use the stride that preceded the fall as a cue to adjust your timing.

en.summary: Cross busy lanes in Rooster Road. Hold to advance, release to wait and pick safe openings while racing other animals to the finish.
en.aboutTitle: Cross lanes at your own pace
about: Rooster Road places your animal on a crowded road with other racers. Holding the mouse button moves you forward. Releasing it stops forward motion or may move the animal slightly back, so check your position before the next push.
Each lane has its own traffic rhythm. You can start across one lane and still run into a vehicle in the next. Look at both lanes before deciding whether a gap gives you time for one move or two.

Other racers can make a narrow gap look inviting. Follow the cars and trucks in your own path before committing. In a practice run, focus on surviving each crossing and learn where you can wait between moves.
steps: Advance with a hold
Click and hold to move the animal forward. Start with a short burst so you can judge how much ground it covers.
Release to wait
Let go before entering a lane with incoming traffic. Check whether the animal shifts backward before aiming for the next gap.
Read two lanes ahead
Look for a place to pause after the first crossing. Move farther only if the next lane is clear for long enough.
Choose your own crossing
When other racers rush ahead, watch the next vehicle instead of copying the group. Take the opening you can actually reach.
faq: What happens when I let go of the mouse button?
Your forward movement stops, and the animal may move slightly backward. Check its position before holding again.
Does hitting a car end the run?
Yes. Contact with traffic or other obstacles can eliminate you from the race.
What should I practice before competitive races?
Practice holding long enough to cross one lane and releasing in time to wait for the next gap.

en.summary: Link corners and build drift scores in Drift Rush. Tune your car, run career events and test your handling on city, mountain and circuit tracks.
en.aboutTitle: Set up a drift that carries into the next corner
about: Drift Rush scores controlled slides around marked areas. Look at your speed and angle on approach. A steady slide through the scoring zone gives you a better chance of carrying momentum into the next bend.

Courses range from tight city corners to mountain routes and circuits. Linked corners reward a clean transition. Set the car up for the next turn as you finish the first, especially when the road changes direction quickly.

Career events unlock cars and customization. Tire, suspension and engine upgrades change how a car behaves. Try a new setup on a familiar event so you can judge whether the change helped your corner exits.
steps: Learn speed and steering controls
Use WASD or the arrow keys to drive. Follow the game's mouse prompts for drift and gear actions.
Approach the drift zone at a manageable speed
Set the car's speed before turning. Watch the marked clipping area as you adjust your angle.
Connect nearby turns
As one slide ends, look into the next corner and set up its approach. Smooth throttle changes give you time to change direction.
Tune one part at a time
Try a tire or suspension change on a track you know. Compare how easily you can hold a slide and straighten up afterward.
faq: What are clipping zones?
They mark areas where the course rewards accurate positioning during a drift.
What can I unlock in Career?
Completed events can open more cars, upgrades and customization options.
What should I adjust if I keep losing the line?
First try a slower approach and a steadier throttle. Once you can repeat the same entry, compare a tire or suspension change.

en.summary: Swing around corners in Arcade Glide. Hold to attach the car to a roadside anchor, release to line up the next stretch and collect gems.
en.aboutTitle: Release the sling as the car lines up with the road
about: Your car accelerates along an endless road. Holding the mouse button near an anchor swings the car around the corner. Releasing detaches it, so your direction at release determines where you head next.

Look at the exit before attaching. Broad curves can give you time to hold the swing, while a tight turn may call for a quicker release. The next anchor can arrive shortly after the previous corner, so leave room to make the next approach.
One collision ends the run. Longer drives can earn more gems and unlock more cars. Use early attempts to learn the release angle on short turns and carry that timing into faster sections.
steps: Attach at a corner
Hold the mouse button when the car reaches a usable anchor. Watch the car start to arc around it.
Release toward open road
Let go when the front of the car points roughly along the next stretch. Follow the exit angle instead of holding for a fixed count.
Prepare for the next anchor
After release, look ahead to the next direction change. A line near the middle gives you room to correct before the next swing.
Adjust to tighter bends
On a short corner, try releasing earlier. If you keep striking the outer wall, watch where the nose of the car points at the moment you let go.
faq: Can I steer the car with the arrow keys?
The published control uses the mouse button. Hold to attach to an anchor and release to detach.
What happens when I hit a barrier?
The crash ends your current run, so the next attempt starts from the beginning.
How do I get more cars?
Survive longer to earn more gems. Progress unlocks additional cars.

en.summary: Defend a fortress against enemy waves, then capture territory in Fortress Clash. Choose units, upgrade defenses and time your general's abilities.
en.aboutTitle: Balance wave defense with territorial conquest
about: Fortress Clash pairs two kinds of strategy. At home, keep enemies away from the base with walls, towers and deployed troops. On the map, take cities to expand your income and support later upgrades.

Units serve different jobs. Swordsmen can hold the front while javelin throwers support them from behind. If the enemy fields cavalry, try adding spearmen before spending on another general-purpose unit.

Town buildings generate gold, and captured territory adds income as you progress. Keep enough resources for the next defense wave before committing to expansion. Save the general's active ability for a moment when several enemies are threatening the same part of the line.
steps: Read the next wave
Look at the incoming formation and decide which units or structures can handle it. Check whether a wall needs attention before deploying more troops.
Give ranged units a frontline
Place durable melee troops ahead of javelin throwers. Use towers to help cover the approach while your troops engage.
Match units to their role
Try spearmen when cavalry threatens the line. Use your own cavalry where its movement can reach positions slower units cannot.
Expand after securing the base
Capture a city when you can sustain the next defense. Use the income to support upgrades and later campaigns.
faq: What produces gold?
Town buildings generate gold. Captured cities can also add income over time.
Which unit is useful against cavalry?
Spearmen are the published counter to cavalry. Keep them near the part of the line the cavalry is approaching.
What does the general do?
The general brings active abilities you can trigger during battle. Time an ability where it can help the units already engaged.

en.summary: Hold and release to guide a multi-car train in Track Dash. Build downhill speed, clear gaps and land with enough cars to keep going.
en.aboutTitle: Keep the train intact through jumps and loops
about: The train travels along an endless series of tracks. Holding the mouse button locks it to the rails and lets it build speed on descents. Release near a crest when the next section gives you room to launch.
Landing is as important as takeoff. A rough landing can knock cars off the train, so follow the angle of the next track while you are in the air. The run ends when the final car is lost.

The route changes from run to run, and tighter gaps become more demanding as you pick up speed. When only a few cars remain, aim for clean, short jumps. Use later attempts to experiment with climbs and loops once you can keep a train together.
steps: Hold on a descent
Hold the mouse button while the train follows a downhill section. Watch where the rails start climbing toward the next ramp.
Release near the crest
Let go near the peak when you need to cross a gap. An earlier release can change the angle if your last landing pitched the train too far.
Watch the landing track
Look for a rail section angled in the direction of travel. Aim for an approach that lets the cars meet the track in sequence.
Adjust after losing a car
If you have only a few cars left, keep the next launch small. Choose a clean return to the rails before trying for more distance.
faq: What happens if I lose one train car?
You can keep going with the cars that remain. Losing the last car ends the run.
How do I build enough speed for a gap?
Hold the train to the rails through the preceding descent, then release as it reaches the crest of the ramp.
Is the course the same each time?
The game generates its endless tracks, so look at the current slopes and gaps instead of relying on a memorized launch point.

en.summary: Bounce rivals toward arena hazards in Sausage Battle. Steer with the mouse or arrow keys and use momentum to become the last sausage standing.
en.aboutTitle: Use space and momentum to stay in the arena
about: Sausage Battle throws you into an arena with other wobbling sausages. You control movement, and attacks happen automatically when rivals are close. The direction and speed of a collision affect where each character goes.

The arena contains hazards that can eliminate a character after a bad bounce. Watch what is behind your target before rushing in. A push toward open ground is easier to recover from when another rival is approaching.

Crowds change the path of a collision. Look for one rival you can approach from open space and give yourself room to move after contact. Each round comes down to staying out of hazards until just one sausage remains.
steps: Steer across the arena
Drag the mouse or use the arrow keys. Move into striking distance to trigger the automatic attack.
Look beyond the rival
Check where both characters might bounce after the collision. Keep a route back into open space.
Wait for an opening in a crowd
Let nearby clashes clear before approaching. Enter from a direction that gives you room to turn.
Change direction early near hazards
Leave extra space around blades and other hazards. A late turn can carry your character into danger even after you change input.
faq: Which button attacks?
Attacks trigger automatically near opponents. Use movement to control the approach and angle.
How does a round end?
The last sausage left in the arena wins.
Why did my character bounce away after a hit?
Collisions affect both characters. Your speed, approach angle and nearby obstacles can all change where you end up.

en.summary: Break office props for combos in Office Fury. Plan your route through timed rooms and spend earned coins on tools and upgrades.
en.aboutTitle: Plan a combo route through each office
about: Office Fury sends you through a cartoon workplace with breakable objects and a timer. Each destroyed object adds to your score. Groups of desks and equipment give you a chance to build a combo without crossing empty floor.

Tight rooms can slow a run if you have to double back. Clear props in the order you can reach them, then leave through the opening that puts you closest to the next group. Watch the timer on crossings between rooms.

Coins earned during runs help unlock improvements. The game also offers boosts such as temporary speed increases and special attacks. Try a boost where it helps you cover a long gap or clear a packed area before the chain ends.
steps: Move through the office
Use WASD or the arrow keys and look for a cluster of objects you can reach without a long detour.
Use the action key in range
Press Space or L to attack or interact. Move toward the next prop as soon as the first one breaks.
Finish near the next room
Pick the first cluster so its last objects leave you by a useful exit. Avoid retracing an empty path when the combo is still active.
Compare upgrades on a familiar route
Spend earned coins on an improvement, then replay a layout you know to see where it saves time.
faq: Which keys break objects?
Press Space or L when the character is within reach. Move with WASD or the arrow keys.
How do I keep a combo going?
Link objects close enough to destroy one after another. Look for the next group before the current one runs out.
What are coins and boosts for?
Coins buy upgrades between runs. Boosts can improve movement or attacks during a run.

en.summary: Aim and release shots in Bow Battle, a physics archery game with solo duels and a challenge mode that adds upgrades between floors.
en.aboutTitle: Use the last shot to judge the next one
about: Bow Battle uses a drag gesture to aim and set shot strength. After release, each arrow follows an arc across the screen. Watch whether the shot lands short or sails past before changing your next drag.

Characters can shift after a hit, so the previous aim may no longer line up. Look at the new positions and check which arrow type you have selected. Try one small adjustment before changing both aim and strength.

Single Play puts you in duels against AI. Challenge Mode takes you through floors and offers random upgrades. Choose an upgrade you can use with the shot pattern you have been practicing, then test it on the next opponent.
steps: Set aim and strength with a drag
Drag the mouse to aim and set power, then release to fire.
Read how the arrow traveled
Watch where a missed shot passes the target. Adjust the next drag slightly so you can see how the change affects the arc.
Recheck the positions after a hit
Physics can move the characters. Take a moment to see where they have settled before repeating the last shot.
Adapt to challenge upgrades
Check the offered upgrades between floors. Pick one that suits your current arrow type or the difficulty you just encountered.
faq: Which controls aim and fire?
Drag the mouse to set the shot, then release the mouse button to fire.
How is Challenge Mode different from Single Play?
Single Play features AI duels. Challenge Mode adds floors and random upgrades as you progress.
Why did the same drag miss on the next shot?
A hit can change where characters are standing. Check the new position and adjust the drag before firing again.

en.summary: Line up baseball-style swings in Ship Smasher. Clear waves of targets, adjust to moving hazards and save special abilities for tough encounters.
en.aboutTitle: Set up each swing as the targets change
about: Ship Smasher puts baseball-style swings at the center of an arcade course. Guide the batter toward approaching targets and try to clear enough space to keep moving. A missed hit can leave a target in the way of the next one.
Levels introduce moving hazards, rows of obstacles and boss encounters. Read the nearest target first, then look past it for the opening you want to reach after the swing.

Power-ups and special abilities appear around some encounters. Try them where a tight group of targets is slowing your progress. As you unlock more characters, learn each layout with a familiar batter before changing your approach.
steps: Position the batter
Hold and move the mouse, or use the left and right arrows to adjust movement. Line up with the part of the course you need to clear.
Watch a moving target before committing
Track its direction as you approach and move into line early enough to meet it with a swing.
Cut an opening through a wave
Start with the target blocking your view or route. Once it is clear, move into position for the next one.
Save an ability for a dense encounter
Use a boost when a boss or a layered set of targets gives you few clear openings. Check which targets are still in your path afterward.
faq: Can I play with the keyboard?
Yes. The left and right arrow keys control movement. You can also hold and move the mouse.
What changes in a boss encounter?
A boss gives you fewer easy openings. Watch its position and use the available abilities when they can help you clear the way.
Why do I keep missing moving targets?
You may be arriving at the place the target just left. Watch where it is headed before moving the batter.

en.summary: Protect Jon's refrigerator in Garfield War. Move Garfield along the front, spend popcorn on allies and upgrade your defense between waves.
en.aboutTitle: Keep a frontline between the invaders and the fridge
about: Waves of food invaders move toward Jon's refrigerator. Garfield attacks automatically as you reposition him, and summoned allies help cover the space between the wave and the fridge.
Popcorn pays for allies, so spending it all early can leave you short when a stronger enemy arrives. Recruit enough help to hold the current wave and watch how quickly the next group approaches.

Upgrades can strengthen units, improve the fridge or open new abilities. Look at what failed in the last wave. If enemies keep getting past your frontline, strengthen the units you rely on before changing the rest of your setup.
steps: Move Garfield along the line
Use the left and right arrows to reposition Garfield. His basic attack happens automatically.
Use popcorn to summon allies
Use the mouse to interact with the available summon options. Bring in help before the wave reaches the fridge.
Reinforce a weak point
Watch where tougher invaders slow down your front. Move Garfield there or summon another ally if you have popcorn to spare.
Upgrade for the next wave
Review the unit, ability and fridge upgrades. Pick one that addresses what gave your defense trouble on the previous wave.
faq: Do I press a key for Garfield's normal attack?
No. He attacks automatically. Use the arrow keys to move him and the mouse to interact.
What is popcorn used for?
Spend popcorn to summon allies that help defend the refrigerator.
Can I improve the fridge itself?
Yes. Fridge improvements are among the upgrades alongside stronger units and additional abilities.

en.summary: Arrange in-game devices and run ragdoll tests in Lab Havoc. Observe the physics, compare the score and use earned currency to unlock tools.
en.aboutTitle: Change one part of the virtual test at a time
about: Lab Havoc is a cartoon sandbox built around a test chamber. Use the mouse to place virtual devices, then start a run and watch how the game moves the ragdoll around the room.
A test produces an in-game score and earns rewards. After the run, look at which devices actually activated. If many stayed idle, move one item and compare the next result.

Earned currency unlocks more tools. Start with a layout you understand so you can see what a new item changes. Repeat the same test a few times if the physics sends the ragdoll down a different path on each run.
steps: Place the first few devices
Use the mouse to position items in the virtual chamber. Start with a simple layout you can watch without losing track of what happened.
Run the simulation
Activate the test and follow the movement on screen. Note which part of the layout the ragdoll reaches first.
Compare two runs
Change one item's placement and start another test. Compare what activated and how the game scored the result.
Try new tools in a familiar setup
Spend earned currency on an unlock, then add it to a layout you already know. Review what changed once the test finishes.
faq: What controls are used in the chamber?
Use the mouse to place and adjust devices and to interact with the test controls.
What earns currency?
Completed tests produce a score and rewards based on the simulation.
Why did the same layout behave differently?
The ragdoll responds to the game's physics. Small differences in the sequence of collisions can change the path it follows.

en.summary: Stay ahead of the Eye God in Ruby Raid. Jump over gaps, clear threats in your path and collect rubies for a random in-game weapon.
en.aboutTitle: Separate jump timing from shot timing
about: Ruby Raid keeps your character running through a shifting space landscape. The Eye God pursues from behind while gaps and enemies appear ahead. Watch the ground first so you have time to jump when the route drops away.

Ground and airborne enemies can call for different timing. When a gap and an enemy appear together, read where the jump will take you. Use the attack key when the threat is in a useful position during that movement.

Red rubies can be exchanged for a randomly selected weapon. A different weapon may behave better against one kind of threat than another. Use the next clear stretch to get used to its timing before trying a close pass.
steps: Jump when a gap approaches
Use the left arrow or Space. Look beyond the gap so you can see where the runner is likely to land.
Clear a threat in front of you
Press the right arrow to fire the equipped in-game weapon. Watch where enemies enter the running line.
Read mixed obstacles early
When a gap follows an enemy, plan the jump while the gap is still ahead. Fit the shot into that path.
Try the next weapon on an open stretch
Spend rubies for a random weapon and learn its rhythm against the first available target before taking a tighter route.
faq: Which keys jump and attack?
Use the left arrow or Space to jump. Use the right arrow to attack.
What do red rubies unlock?
You can exchange them for a randomly selected in-game weapon. The result can change how you approach the next run.
Do I need to hold a key to run?
No. The runner moves automatically. You control jumps and attacks as the path changes.

en.summary: Guide an arrow in flight in Sky Dart. Make small corrections, aim for coin targets and spend your earnings on power, control or income.
en.aboutTitle: Keep a steady flight path between targets
about: The launch sets the direction of your first flight in Sky Dart. Once the arrow is moving, it gradually loses speed. Smooth corrections help you stay on an open route as obstacles come into view.

Targets offer coin bonuses. Hitting the target doubles the coin reward, and a bullseye awards four times the coins. If reaching one would take the arrow through an obstacle, look farther ahead for a target you can approach more cleanly.

Distance also earns currency. Spend it on power, control or earnings, then try a similar flight so you can feel what changed. If you already reach targets consistently, use an open route to practice lining up with a boost ring.
steps: Line up a clear launch
Choose a direction with room for the first correction. Watch how far forward the arrow travels as it starts to slow.
Make small changes in flight
Guide the arrow away from obstacles with small adjustments. Let each change take effect before adding another.
Choose targets you can reach smoothly
Aim toward the center when you have an open approach. Prefer the next target if the current one requires a sudden turn.
Compare an upgrade on a similar run
Spend earned coins on power, control or earnings. Try the same opening again so you can see the effect of that choice.
faq: What does a bullseye pay?
The official rules list double coins for a target hit and four times the coins for a bullseye.
Why does the arrow lose distance late in a run?
The arrow naturally slows in flight. Large adjustments or obstacles can reduce how far it goes.
What can I upgrade?
The listed upgrade areas are power, control and earnings. Pick the one that matches the part of the run you want to improve.

en.summary: Time your steps in Wacky Steps. Adjust your stride to land between sidewalk cracks, avoid moving hazards and reach the next checkpoint.
en.aboutTitle: Choose a landing spot before extending your stride
about: In Wacky Steps, holding the input extends the character's stride. A short hold helps you land on a small patch of pavement. A longer hold lets you reach across a crack, provided the character can keep its balance.
Traffic and unstable tiles can interrupt the rhythm that works on an empty sidewalk. Look beyond the foot you are placing to see whether the next patch gives you room to stop or prepare another step.

Coins reward clean routes through the course. Checkpoints can recover some of your progress after a mistake. Learn the stretch between two checkpoints before taking a longer stride toward a coin beside a hazard.
steps: Set the stride with the mouse
Click and hold to extend the step. Release when the foot can land on a clear patch.
Look at the next two footholds
Pick a landing spot between cracks, then check whether it gives you room for another step.
Shorten the step in crowded sections
Use a shorter hold when traffic or an unstable tile limits the safe pavement.
Practice from a checkpoint
If the same crack ends several attempts, adjust the preceding stride first so you approach it from a better position.
faq: What does holding the mouse longer do?
It extends the stride. If the character reaches too far, it can lose balance and fall.
What happens if I step on a crack?
Landing on a crack can end the attempt. Aim for a clear section of pavement before you commit each stride.
Are there other routes to try?
The game offers environments and modes with different obstacles. Use the opening stretch to learn the timing of each route.

en.summary: Survive waves of zombies in Undead Corridor. Read the room, manage your in-game health and ammo, and try different weapons in Training.
en.aboutTitle: Choose the right mode and manage the wave
about: Undead Corridor sends zombie waves through cramped game maps. Your health does not regenerate during a survival attempt, so check which side is closing in before moving into a tighter space.

Different modes change the rules. Corridor gives you one attempt and reacts to noise. Defense focuses on holding a barricade, while Rooms gives you smaller areas to clear. Check the mode before assuming your equipment will carry over.
Earned in-game currency unlocks weapons with different firing behavior. Training gives you a place to learn aim, reload timing and movement without managing a survival run.
steps: Move sideways with A and D
Use the two keys to adjust your position in the corridor. Keep approaching zombies on screen as you shift.
Use the mouse to aim and fire
Point at a zombie in the game, then use the left mouse button to fire.
Make room if a zombie closes in
Press Space to use the game's kick. Watch the gap it creates before moving or pressing another control.
Reload during a break
Press R when you have space between waves. Try the timing in Training before using it during a crowded run.
faq: Can I test weapons without an ongoing wave?
Yes. Training lets you try weapons without the pressure of survival mode.
Does health regenerate during a run?
No. Damage stays with you during the attempt, so a close encounter can affect the rest of the wave.
Do weapons carry over when I die?
The rules depend on the mode. Rooms and Street retain weapons after a death, while Defense can remove them after repeated deaths.

en.summary: Time rocket stage releases in Lift Off 2. Earn coins from each launch, improve rocket parts and use planetary income to fund later flights.
en.aboutTitle: Time each separation and reinvest the launch rewards
about: Lift Off 2 focuses on the moment you release a rocket stage. Waiting can build more thrust, but a stage held too long can fail and end the attempt. Watch for the change near the point where you separated on the previous flight.

Coins from attempts pay for upgrades that change the rocket's parts and improve reach. Try to make a few consistent launches first. They give you a clearer comparison when you buy a part and repeat the flight.

Planetary progress can generate income between launch attempts. When that income becomes available, check what you can buy before launching again. A part that helps your earliest separation can pay off on later stages as well.
steps: Start a launch and watch the active stage
Follow the game's stage display as the rocket climbs. Use the separation input when the stage is ready to release.
Adjust one separation at a time
If the flight ends during a particular stage, try releasing that stage earlier on the next flight while keeping your other inputs similar.
Reinvest in rocket parts
Spend coins on a part that addresses where your flight stops progressing. Try a comparable launch after upgrading.
Check planetary income between launches
As planet systems open, review the income they provide and use it to fund later rocket improvements.
faq: Why did the rocket fail before separation?
Waiting too long on a stage can end the flight. Try triggering separation a little sooner at the stage where it failed.
What are the coins for?
Coins fund rocket parts and upgrades that help extend later flights.
Can progress continue between sessions?
Planetary income can continue while you are away once you have unlocked and established planets.

en.summary: Collect crystals and upgrade mining equipment in Astro Tycoon. Manage backpack capacity, unlock automation and explore deeper planetary layers.
en.aboutTitle: Make each trip from the mine to the base count
about: Astro Tycoon starts on layered terrain with a vacuum tool for gathering crystals. Follow a route with several nearby deposits so you spend more of the trip collecting and less of it traveling back toward the base.

Backpack capacity determines how much you can carry before returning. If it fills close to the start of each trip, compare a storage upgrade with a tool upgrade. Improve the tool when collection speed is holding you back.

Workers and machines become available as the mine develops. Fossils can also unlock bonuses through revived pets. Review what your base is producing before committing the next trip to deeper deposits.
steps: Move to a cluster of crystals
Use WASD or the arrow keys. Follow the visible terrain and look for deposits along the return route.
Return when your storage is nearly full
Use the base and its mission positions to interact with the game. Compare the haul with the time it took to reach it.
Check missions and the shop
Use Q for daily missions and quests, E for the shop and O for the space map.
Compare storage and tool upgrades
Increase capacity if the backpack sends you back early. Improve the tool if reaching and collecting from harder layers takes too much time.
faq: Why do I need to return to base?
Returning lets you use the resources you collected and access upgrades. Keeping a short route helps when storage is limited.
How can I open daily missions?
Press Q. At in-game mission positions, standing in the marked area can also trigger an interaction.
What can I unlock beyond better tools?
Progress can open workers, machines and additional equipment. Fossils can lead to pets that provide mining bonuses.

en.summary: Collect animals and return to your base in Escape Animals. Avoid the changing hazards and upgrade your collection to earn more income.
en.aboutTitle: Plan the return route before picking up an animal
